# Tubelight

> Tubelight is a visual learning platform and AI desktop visual explainer built for Windows 10 and 11. Highlight any text in a PDF, document, or browser window and press Alt + E. Tubelight immediately docks beside your active work and explains the passage with illustrated, animated vector diagrams, dynamic captions, and synchronized voice narration.

## Core Products
- **Tubelight Visual Explainer**: Desktop application for Windows (Alt + E) providing side-by-side illustrated explanations, vector flowcharts, anatomies, and synchronized voice narration.
- **Quick Search AI**: Desktop companion application for Windows (Hold Tab + Q) delivering instant voice and screen queries with cited sources and spoken answers.

- [Visual Examples & Topic Search](https://tubelight.net/#examples): Watch sample explanations or generate a live free visual preview.
- [Join Early Access](https://tubelight.net/#join): Windows early-access waitlist with batch invitations.
- [Product Architecture & Privacy FAQ](https://tubelight.net/#faq): Local device storage, secure in-memory processing, and zero source document retention.
- [Download Tubelight for Windows](https://tubelight.net/download): Direct installer download for Windows 10 & 11.
- [Tubelight Pro Upgrade](https://tubelight.net/upgrade): Unlimited visual generations and advanced steering options.
- [Quick Search AI Landing Page](https://search.tubelight.net/): The dedicated voice and screen search companion for Windows.
- [Quick Search AI Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9NFK7MS99FB3): Install Quick Search AI free on Windows.
